headline: 10 tourists killed in Cox's Bazar resort fire; resort operated without fire safety licence
summary: A devastating fire at the Tuptup Resto & Resort in Cox's Bazar has claimed the lives of 10 tourists. The resort was found to be operating without a fire safety licence and had previously been warned about its hazardous condition.
details: Ten tourists have died in a fire that engulfed the Tuptup Resto & Resort in the Patuartek area of Inani Beach, Cox's Bazar. The resort, a three-storey wooden structure, was completely destroyed by the blaze. Four people were injured and have been hospitalized.

The Fire Service and Civil Defence (FSCD) revealed that the resort was operating without a fire safety licence and had been formally notified as a "hazardous" structure in June. Despite the warning and notice, the business continued to operate.

Officials stated that the resort lacked adequate fire extinguishers and proper firefighting measures. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation, and the identities of the deceased are yet to be confirmed.
The fire broke out at approximately 7:25 AM, with two fire service units arriving at the scene by 8:00 AM. The blaze was brought under control by 11:00 AM after burning for several hours.

headline_marked: Fire erupts at [[Ibn Sina Pharmaceutical]] factory in Gazipur
headline: Fire erupts at Ibn Sina Pharmaceutical factory in Gazipur
summary: A fire broke out at the Ibn Sina Pharmaceutical factory in Kaliakair, Gazipur. Firefighters battled the blaze, which started in the herbal section and quickly spread.
details: A fire broke out at the Ibn Sina Pharmaceutical factory in the Sofipur area of Kaliakair upazila, Gazipur, on Saturday afternoon.
The fire started around 4:30 PM and was brought under control by 5:35 PM by six units of the fire service.
The blaze reportedly originated in the factory's herbal section and rapidly engulfed other parts of the facility.
The cause of the fire is currently unknown, and there have been no immediate reports of casualties.
This incident follows a similar fire at the Drug International factory in Tongi, Gazipur, just days prior, which took approximately four hours to extinguish.
